_manual._how: Each video below came up under YouTube's Creative Commons filter, but YouTube blocks scripted access from servers (GitHub Actions and our build box get 'confirm you're not a bot'), so neither the license nor a frame can be fetched automatically. To use one: open it, check the description says 'Creative Commons Attribution license (reuse allowed)', grab a clean front frame, upload it to Commons with {{From YouTube}} and {{YouTube CC-BY}} so it gets a license review, then add a normal Commons entry. Steps in docs/DEVICES.md.
